title: Rockstar Games Union Vote Scheduled During GTA6 Window
description: Rockstar Games employees have locked in a union vote for next month, taking place over the Grand Theft Auto 6 release window.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Rockstar Games Employees Lock In Union Vote Date

According to a recent report by Eurogamer, a date has officially been locked in for Rockstar Games employees to vote on whether to officially recognise their developer union.

### Timing Over the GTA6 Release Window

Significantly, this upcoming union vote is scheduled to take place right over the release window of **Grand Theft Auto 6**. The timing places the internal labor discussions directly alongside one of the biggest product launches in entertainment history.

### Potential Industry Milestone

If the vote proves successful, the resulting organisation will officially become the largest recognised union across the entirety of the UK video games industry. This milestone could set a powerful precedent for worker representation and labour conditions within major UK-based game development studios.

## Editor's Take

Scheduling a union vote during the intense release window of a blockbuster like GTA6 highlights a crucial moment for developer advocacy. It remains to be seen how this vote will shape the internal culture at Rockstar and potentially influence the wider UK gaming landscape.
